_comment: Canonical listing store. Every entry under `listings` is a live, status=Active listing in the MetroList MLS feed as of `lastRun`, verified against its own listing page. Do not promote anything here from search-engine text — see README 'Verification gate'.
provenance: Listings come from the Redfin GIS/CSV export for ZIPs 95667, 95672 and 95682, filtered to status=Active. That export is MetroList MLS data, not a search-engine summary, so listing status is live rather than cached. Every property that passed the bed/bath/price/acreage filter then had its own listing page fetched and parsed for the structured `hasPrivatePool` flag and the MLS Pool Information block — the pool requirement is verified per-listing, never inferred from marketing copy.
caveats: Redfin's export carries a standard disclaimer that some MLS listings are withheld from download under local MLS rules, so this is a very good sample of inventory rather than a guaranteed-complete one. Cross-checking against a second portal was not possible this run — Zillow, Realtor.com, Homes.com, Trulia and Movoto all refuse requests from this environment's IP range. Acreage is the MLS lot-size field and is sometimes rounded. Confirm anything that matters with the listing agent before acting on it.

Step inside to discover a beautifully updated home with 4 bedrooms, 3 baths, and an inviting upstairs game room complete with a wet bar perfect for gatherings. The renovated kitchen shines with quartz counters, stainless appliances, and beautiful white cabinetry, flowing seamlessly into the family room with soaring ceilings, a warm woodstove, and expansive slider that frames the tranquil outdoors. listings.remarks: Sought after area. Minutes from shopping, schools. Country living at its finest. Situated in a serene, park-like setting, this property offers unparalleled tranquility. End of road privacy. This custom-built two story family residence offers four bedrooms, a formal dining room, separate living and family spaces, and a chef's dream kitchen, complemented by three bathrooms. Additionally, there is a three-car detached garage connected via a breezeway to the main residence. Above the garage, you'll find a versatile game room that can serve as a teen hangout or man cave, which could easily be transformed into a one-bedroom apartment complete with a full bath. The stunning built-in pool is bordered by vibrant flowers and lush greenery, enhancing the outdoor experience. From the property, enjoy distant views of Sacramento and the spectacular fireworks displays during the Fourth of July celebrations. The home is set on nearly six acres, featuring fenced areas, a loafing shed, and various other structures.
